text:
Korean President Lee Jae Myung and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney agreed Thursday to continue their cooperation to build stable and mutually beneficial energy supply chains.
The two leaders reached the agreement during a bilateral meeting held on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen, China.
Lee and Carney reviewed energy cooperation between their countries and agreed to continue cooperation to build stable and mutually beneficial energy supply chains, Lee's spokesperson Kim Sung-wan said in a release.
The leaders also agreed to jointly seek international cooperation regarding artificial intelligence innovation and safety, Kim said.
